comments.author: @ADayInTravels
comments.text: The opening aerials really set the tone, and I liked how the chapters move from Tokyo to Mount Fuji to the bamboo forest in Kyoto. My tip for anyone using this as a planning starting point is to pick one region per trip instead of trying to cover them all. I did Tokyo and Kyoto on separate trips and both felt much less rushed. Miyajima at sunset is still one of my favorite memories from Japan.
